about: Every bitmap claim of a block from 942,000 on, read from every block from 942,000 to 954,361 by bop's rules: the body exactly "N.bitmap", no leading zero, no compression, no delegate, made in block N or later. claims[N][0] is the real claim (the first, in Bitcoin order); the rest are later copies. Below 942,000 bop's on-chain index says which claim is real.
